config.title: How to Get Into Berghain - FAQ
config.subtitle: What you can prepare, what remains subjective, and how to plan the exact event.

items.q: How do you get into Berghain?
items.a: There is no published formula and no guaranteed method. Read the exact official programme, bring physical photo ID, wear something suitable for that event and for dancing, keep the queue calm and private, and accept the decision without arguing. These steps make you a prepared and respectful guest; they do not predict admission.

items.q: What time should I arrive at Berghain?
items.a: Use the start time and running order on the exact event page. Recent 2026 Saturday Klubnacht listings commonly show 23:59, while Friday club events can start at 22:00 and concerts can publish separate door and show times. Pick an hour for the artists you want and the rest you have had. No arrival time guarantees admission.

items.q: What is the Berghain dress code, and how much does it cost?
items.a: There is no universal published black-uniform rule. Wear something suitable for the exact party and for hours of dancing, and follow any event-specific theme or dress note. Prices and payment methods can change by event, so check the current listing and carry both a payment card and some cash rather than trusting an old blog figure.

items.q: Why are photos banned inside Berghain?
items.a: Official Berghain event listings ask visitors to respect a no-photo and no-video policy. Keep your phone away and do not record people without consent. Berghain's awareness guidance also asks guests to respect personal space and consent, look after friends, stay hydrated and involve staff when someone needs help.

items.q: What are good alternatives to Berghain in Berlin?
items.a: Berlin alternatives include Sisyphos in Rummelsburg, Kater Blau at Holzmarkt, ://about blank in Friedrichshain, Tresor inside Kraftwerk and RSO in Schöneweide. Choose by the exact event, music and rules, not by a promise of an easier door. Check each venue's official current programme, address, ticket status and admission notes during the week you go.
